children: EQT reported third-quarter 2026 net income attributable to EQT of $279 million and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.42. Net cash provided by operating activities was $1.08 billion, while free cash flow attributable to EQT was $283 million. The company also announced a strategic acquisition of Range Resources.
Total operating revenues were $1.77 billion, compared with $1.96 billion in the third quarter of 2025.
Operating income was $459 million, versus $603 million a year earlier.
Net income was $345 million; net income attributable to EQT was $279 million, compared with $407 million and $336 million, respectively, in the prior-year quarter.
Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.42, compared with $0.52 in the third quarter of 2025.

Net cash provided by operating activities was $1.08 billion, and free cash flow attributable to EQT, a non-GAAP measure, was $283 million. EQT ended the quarter with $5.6 billion of total debt and $5.5 billion of net debt.
Sales volume was 583 Bcfe, including 21 Bcfe of strategic curtailments.
EQT announced a strategic acquisition of Range Resources, which the company expects to create a vertically integrated natural gas producer with expanded resource depth and marketing capabilities.
The company launched an open season for the 42-inch POWER Pipeline, planned to connect its Pennsylvania Marcellus assets with demand at the Clarington hub in Ohio.
EQT signed a 10-year LNG sales agreement with Ignitis Group and contracted for 7 Bcf of additional Gulf Coast storage capacity at Leaf River Energy Center.
For the fourth quarter, EQT expects sales volume of 550–600 Bcfe, including 10–20 Bcfe of strategic curtailments, and plans to turn in line 16–26 net wells.
